title: Limiting Behavior of Degree-Degree Metrics under Local Convergence in Probability
summary: This paper investigates the limiting behaviour of degree-degree correlation metrics for sequences of random graphs under a general assumption of local convergence in probability. We establish convergence results for Pearson's correlation coefficient r, Spearman's rho, Kendall's tau, average nearest neighbour degree (ANND), and average nearest neighbour rank (ANNR). Our results explicitly show how the limits of these degree-degree correlation metrics depend on the local structure of the graph.
